Legal · Updated October 2026

Privacy policy

This policy explains what personal information Invenio Homes collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. It applies to this website and to enquiries made through it.

Privacy policyCookie policyTerms of use

Who is responsible

Invenio Homes S.L. (NIF B16649519), with its office in Santa Eulària des Riu, Ibiza, is the controller of the personal data collected through this website.

For any question about this policy or your data, write to find@inveniohomes.com.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry we collect the details you choose to give us: your name, email address, telephone number, the dates and destination you are interested in, and anything you write in the message.

We also receive basic technical information when you visit the site — the pages you view, the device and browser you use, and the approximate region you are connecting from. We use this only to understand how the site is working.

Why we use it

We use your information to answer your enquiry, to prepare a selection or an offer, to manage a booking or an owner relationship, and to keep records we are required to keep.

We do not sell your data, and we do not add you to a marketing list without asking.

Legal bases

Where you ask us to do something before entering a contract, we rely on that step being taken at your request. Where we manage an existing relationship, we rely on the performance of the contract. For essential site security and fraud prevention, we rely on our legitimate interest. Where consent is required — for example for non-essential cookies — we ask for it separately and you can withdraw it at any time.

How long we keep it

Enquiries that do not lead to a booking are kept for 24 months. Booking and accounting records are kept for the period required by Spanish law. You can ask us to delete anything we are not legally required to keep.

Who we share it with

We share information only where it is needed to deliver the service: with the owner or agency responsible for a property, with our booking and accounting providers, and with professional advisers. Those providers are bound by confidentiality and data-processing terms.

Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where that happens, we use appropriate safeguards, including the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

Your rights

You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its use, and receive it in a portable format. You also have the right to withdraw consent at any time.

Write to find@inveniohomes.com and we will respond within one month. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD) or the authority in your country of residence.

Changes

We may update this policy to reflect changes in the law or in our service. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last reviewed.
